scripts.build: npm run build -w @jkopay/contracts && npm run build -w @jkopay/bff && npm run build -w @jkopay/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n contracts,bff,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @jkopay/contracts" "npm run dev -w @jkopay/bff" "npm run dev -w @jkopay/web"
scripts.prisma:setup: npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:migrate && npm run prisma:seed
scripts.test: npm run test -w @jkopay/bff && npm run test -w @jkopay/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration -w @jkopay/bff && npm run test:integration -w @jkopay/web
